verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Snyk shipping its own MCP server (and CLI/IDE hooks) so that external coding agents/ADEs can call Snyk's scanning and remediation tools — i.e., Snyk acts as the MCP server/tool provider, not as a client consuming external MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence that Snyk's Remediation Agent, Snyk Studio, or CLI can be configured to plug into and call tools exposed by third-party MCP servers.
